title: Three Column Computation Layout
description: Computation nodes should be three columns (input rows | vertical name | output rows), not a full grid with horizontal channel dividers.
summary: Cleared spurious horizontal artifacts in the computation name column: repaint an opaque center-column fill after port labels to mask halo/wire bleed, keep only vertical section dividers, and render the node title as stacked vertical glyphs instead of a rotated horizontal label box.
